Title: Rewind time inf and action cards

Messages.Author: Thetmes
Messages.Body:
Hi guys,

In a game with friends we came to a question :

Can rewind time at temporis inferior cancel all actions playable with cards (equipments, allies, votes...)?

Card text states for temporis inf:
"Cancel an action card as it is played (the acting minion is not locked)."

Thanks for your help.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Thetmes wrote:
> Hi guys,
>
> In a game with friends we came to a question :
>
> Can rewind time at temporis inferior cancel all actions playable with cards (equipments, allies, votes...)?
>
> Card text states for temporis inf:
> "Cancel an action card as it is played (the acting minion is not locked)."
>
> Thanks for your help.
>
Equipment and ally cards are action cards, yes.

I suppose that you mean "political action card" by "votes". Political action cards are also action cards.
